architecture.summary: The Connect portal and server-rendered administration pages use one compact header menu: Connect, Switch Workspace, Members, Audit Log. The portal shows Members and Audit Log only for the existing exact admin grant. The web and user-portal owners retain separate renderers and styles. Existing routes, server access checks, browser session authority, public interfaces, dependencies, containers, and deployment remain unchanged. Registry prose names the menu; all diagrams remain accurate.
